title: Senior Digital Marketing Manager
description:
THE ROLE 📝

We’re looking for a Senior Digital Marketing Manager to lead Form3’s digital growth and demand generation strategy, helping drive pipeline growth and brand development across our priority markets. Reporting to the Marketing Director, you’ll combine strategic ownership with execution across integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, digital acquisition and performance measurement. You’ll also identify practical ways to use AI, automation and marketing technology to improve targeting, personalisation, efficiency and campaign results. You’ll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product and the wider Marketing team, aligning marketing activity with commercial priorities and identifying opportunities within strategic accounts.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and own Form3’s digital growth and demand generation strategy.
  • Create go-to-market plans for products, propositions, markets and strategic announcements.
  • Create integrated, multi-channel programmes that generate awareness, engagement, qualified leads and pipeline.
  • Build account-based marketing programmes for high-value prospects and strategic accounts.
  • Use AI, automation and marketing technology to improve targeting, personalisation, lead generation and campaign performance.
  • Monitor performance across the marketing funnel and make insight-led recommendations.
  • Improve website performance, conversion rates, user journeys and marketing-driven engagement.


WE’RE LOOKING FOR 🔍

Essential

  • 6+ years’ experience in B2B digital marketing, demand generation or campaign management.
  • Strong experience developing campaign strategies and delivering integrated marketing campaigns.
  • Proven ability to link marketing investment to revenue growth and return on investment.
  • Expertise in account-based marketing, audience segmentation, pipeline generation and campaign activation.
  • Practical experience using AI, automation and marketing technology to improve campaign performance.
  • Strong digital marketing capability across websites, landing pages, email, paid media, search and social, with the breadth and depth to lead an integrated digital strategy.
  • Strong analytical and performance-reporting skills, combined with a commercial and customer-focused approach.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions.

Desirable

  • Experience within technology, SaaS, Fintech or payments.
  • Experience working within a start-up/scale-up environment.
  • Working experience across multiple markets e.g. UK/Europe/NA
  • Familiarity with tooling such as Salesforce, Pardot, Salesloft, Cognism, ZoomInfo.

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS ✍️

Stage One: Screening Call with the Talent Team

Stage Two: Interview with Marketing Director

Stage Three: Case Study & Presentation with Marketing Team

Stage Four: Interview with Head of Commercial Operations

We always aim to stick to the above process; however, there may be occasions when an additional interview stage is required for us to be sure we are hiring the right person!

 

HIRING LOCATIONS 📍

Here are the locations that we are hiring from for this position:

  • United Kingdom

All new joiners start their first day in our office to collect the equipment needed to work remotely. We'll also arrange for some of your team to come in to say hi, ensuring you're supported and have a positive first few days with Form3!

 

BENEFITS 🏝️

Form3 are a 100% remote, flexible business and are able to offer part-time working arrangements. We believe this enables our people to achieve amazing things with a healthy work-life balance.

For further information on what it’s like to work here, and for more information on our full benefits package, visit our careers page. If you have any other questions, we’d be happy to discuss these with you during the interview process.

title: Senior Quality Engineer - MONOPOLY GO!
description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Quality Engineer to join the MONOPOLY GO! team. The role can be based remotely in the UK, or in Barcelona or Seville on a hybrid basis, with three days a week in the office.

 

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day—whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating across the games industry, connecting millions of players around the world every day.

The MONOPOLY GO! Tech Vertical develops the platforms, services, and engineering capabilities that support a reliable, responsive mobile gaming experience.We are building a Quality Engineering organization that embeds quality throughout development through automation, continuous validation, and shared engineering ownership.

 

 

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Quality Engineer who enjoys writing code, solving complex problems, and building tools that help teams deliver with confidence. Reporting to the Quality Director of Tech, you will help establish our QE capabilities through hands-on development of automation frameworks, test infrastructure, and quality insights across mobile, Unity, APIs, integrations, performance, and CI/CD.

You will help build our Quality Engineering capabilities incrementally, prioritizing the areas of greatest risk and value with the team. We are building these capabilities while supporting an active live-service game. You will take ownership of immediate testing needs, including manual, exploratory, and release validation, while developing sustainable automation and tooling. A willingness to test directly is essential. You will use what you learn to guide automation priorities, while recognizing the continuing value of exploratory testing, and develop practical AI capabilities that improve engineering effectiveness.

 

What You Will Do

  • Build reusable engineering solutions. Write, review, debug, and maintain automation frameworks, tools, and test infrastructure that other engineers can adopt and extend.
  • Improve testability from the start. Participate in technical design and code reviews to identify risks early and improve test hooks, service interfaces, and diagnostic capabilities.
  • Balance building with hands-on testing. Perform manual, exploratory, and release testing where automation is not yet available or direct investigation provides greater value. Meet current delivery needs while building sustainable solutions.
  • Develop mobile and Unity automation. Automate Android, iOS, and Unity workflows, accounting for device differences, application lifecycle events, network conditions, and client performance.
  • Strengthen API and integration testing. Validate backend services, service contracts, client-server interactions, data integrity, and failure recovery through reliable automated tests.
  • Validate player-state consistency and recovery. Test interrupted sessions, reconnects, retries, and client-server synchronization to help protect player progress and data integrity.
  • Investigate failures across systems. Use logs, metrics, traces, crash reports, and telemetry to investigate client, backend, and integration failures, support root-cause analysis, and turn findings into regression coverage.
  • Validate mobile and backend performance. Profile frame rate, memory usage, application startup, crashes, and responsiveness. Develop backend load, stress, and endurance tests, establish meaningful baselines, and investigate bottlenecks and regressions with engineers.
  • Apply risk-based testing. Prioritize validation by player impact, technical complexity, change scope, and failure history. Combine service-level tests, targeted end-to-end automation, and exploratory testing.
  • Integrate validation into CI/CD. Deliver reliable automated feedback, useful diagnostics, and maintainable quality checks. Improve test stability and execution time, with clear ownership of failures.
  • Improve test data and environments. Build utilities, fixtures, and repeatable setup processes that make testing dependable and defects easier to reproduce.
  • Develop AI-assisted quality workflows. Build and evaluate solutions for test generation, failure triage, regression selection, and coverage analysis, with human review and measurable outcomes.
  • Strengthen telemetry validation and quality visibility. Partner with engineering and analytics to validate telemetry accuracy, completeness, duplicates, schema changes, and data freshness. Query large datasets to investigate issues and build quality dashboards that inform risk assessment and release decisions.
  • Help establish the QE organization. Contribute standards, documentation, reusable patterns, and mentoring. Partner with developers, Quality Analysts, and technical leaders to strengthen shared ownership of quality.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrated quality engineering, software development in test, or software engineering experience, including hands-on ownership of automation used by other engineers.
  • Strong programming skills in C# or Python, with the ability to work effectively in Unity and automation codebases. Experience in source control, code reviews, debugging, and maintainable software design.
  • Practical experience testing and automating Android and iOS applications, including device coverage, operating system differences, and unreliable network conditions.
  • Experience developing API and integration tests, diagnosing failures across services and data flows, and integrating reliable automated tests into CI/CD.
  • Working knowledge of performance, risk-based, and exploratory testing, with sound judgment about what to automate and when to investigate directly.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and practical experience with telemetry and big data, including querying large datasets, validating events and data pipelines, and using findings to guide testing and release decisions.
  • Experience with AI-assisted engineering tools and the ability to evaluate the accuracy and usefulness of their outputs.
  • Strong ownership and collaborative problem-solving, with the ability to turn ambiguous needs into practical solutions. A passion for quality, mobile games, AI, and technology.
  • Advanced professional proficiency in spoken and written English, sufficient to participate independently in technical discussions, explain engineering decisions, and write clear documentation with global teams.

 

Additional experience we value

  • Hands-on experience with Unity, C#, Unity Test Framework, or automated testing of Unity-based mobile games.
  • Experience with live-service games, player-state consistency, reconnect behavior, live configuration, or client-server synchronization.
  • Experience with mobile device farms, observability, quality dashboards, or establishing QE capabilities within a growing team.

 

What success looks like

Teams receive faster, more trustworthy feedback and clearer visibility into release risk. Immediate testing needs are met while dependable automation grows around critical player journeys and integrations. Performance regressions surface earlier, failures are easier to diagnose, and repetitive effort decreases. Your tools are maintained, documented, and adopted by other engineers, and AI capabilities demonstrate measurable value.

 

 

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

title: Director of Operations, Slate Development
description:
Scopely is looking for a Director, Slate Operations to join our Slate Development Group team in the UK remotely or in Barcelona, on a flexible hybrid model.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. 

Slate Operations keeps Scopely's game development slate moving. We oversee execution and cross-functional alignment across the games in development — connecting game teams and central teams so decisions get made once and stick, running the cadence that keeps everyone aligned, and clearing the path so teams can build.

What You'll Do:

We're looking for a Director, Slate Operations to own this end to end. There are two sides to it: keeping the Group running as an organization — its cadence, process, and the day-to-day support the Game Board, Head of Slate Development and leadership team rely on — and running program management for the Game Development Framework (GDF) so games move cleanly from concept to launch. You'll sit inside the Slate Development Group but work with every part of Scopely: game teams, divisional leadership, finance, strategy, and corporate development.

 

  • Be the operational point of contact for specific in-development games — running the GDF cadence and connecting game and central teams so decisions get made once and aren't re-litigated. The main goal is to be the end to end steward for game teams in the game development framework.
  • Deliver operational excellence within our internal team, shaping our service model, priorities, and ways of working. Evolve our capabilities as needs change.
  • Drive the cross-slate operating model so independent game teams reuse what already works instead of rebuilding it.
  • Bring structure to consequential decisions — organize the inputs, assumptions, and trade-offs early so the owners and the room can reach real alignment before committing.
  • Own a capstone project — one meaty area you drive end to end, for example: evolving the GDF, owning launch readiness, or operationalizing central partnerships, depending on where the need is. 
  • Keep investment decisions well-informed — track progress across games at different stages, and surface Greenlight Case, budget, staffing, and dependency status so leadership can challenge and decide.
  • Unblock teams through the development cycle, especially at launch readiness, by clearing operational issues with central partners (legal, IT, procurement, finance, logistics) so teams stay focused on the game. Partner with marketing, strategy, and divisional leadership so launches go out clean.
  • Give teams operational support — production perspective, process, facilitation, and help navigating the GDF.
  • Operationalize playtests and validation — help build and run research, playtest, and validation plans, and package the findings so vertical owners and leaders can form the recommendation.
  • Utilize the latest AI technologies to keep information flowing — the dashboards, status, and key dates people need to see, without the overhead.

 

What We’re Looking For: 

  • Bachelor's degree, MBA a plus — or the equivalent in experience.
  • 10+ years in program/project management across tech and direct-to-consumer businesses, at least 5 of them in games, working within or alongside a development team.
  • You know how games get made and sold — development, publishing, platforms, business models. You don't need to have shipped one yourself, but you get what game teams are up against.
  • You've supported senior execs in a fast-moving environment and you like the pace — taking initiative, juggling priorities, switching gears without losing the thread.
  • You can run a lot of projects at once, ideally a mix of R&D and live.
  • You're comfortable in ambiguity and good at creating clarity for other people. You make sound calls in the company's interest and know when to escalate.
  • You can hold your own with P&Ls and free-to-play KPIs.
  • You spot the process that's slowing people down and fix it — and you'll push back and start the right debate when it matters.
  • You build trust with all kinds of people at every level and don't flinch at the hard conversations — with the presence to grow into a partner to senior game leaders over time.
  • You write clearly and fast, and you can build a strong deck with cross-functional input.
  • Detail and organization come naturally to you.
  • Low ego, business outcomes first, open to feedback — and genuinely curious about every part of the business.
  • You play games and care about the industry.

description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

Liftoff is looking for a Commercial Legal Counsel that will assist the in-house legal department with Insertion Orders (Agreements), third party contracts and other legal needs. This position will support the Commercial, Finance and Accounting teams, located around the world. 

As a Commercial Legal Counsel at Liftoff, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless execution of contracts that drive our business forward. You will be at the intersection of legal expertise, meticulous organization, and collaborative teamwork. Your responsibilities will encompass contract drafting, negotiation, process improvement and training. As an essential part of our team, you'll contribute to the foundation of our business relationships and help us navigate the complex world of contracts with precision and efficiency. If you're passionate about detail-oriented work, contract law, and making a meaningful impact, this role is your opportunity to shine. Join us in shaping the way we manage contracts and elevate our commitment to excellence.

Responsibilities:

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts, including vendor agreements, customer contracts, and licensing agreements, to ensure compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including legal, sales/commercial, product, engineering, finance and accounting to understand contract terms, resolve issues, and provide guidance on contractual matters.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date contract ticketing system, respond to each contract ticket in a timely manner and track contract milestones and deadlines.
  • Assist in  contract compliance, addressing any deviations or breaches.
  • Assist in the development and improvement of contract templates and standard clauses.
  • Support the contract approval process, ensuring proper authorization and documentation.
  • Provide guidance and training to employees on contract-related matters and best practices.
  • Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations impacting contract management.

Requirements: 

  • 5-10 Years of experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Law, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Contracts Counsel/Legal Counsel or in a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of contract law and legal terminology.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented with exceptional organizational and time management abilities.
  • Proficiency in contract management software or tools.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment globally.
  • Prior experience in ad-tech is a plus.

Location:

This position is based in London or remotely within the United Kingdom, occasionally going into the office.

This position is a contract position with the potential to become a full-time employee. The expected hours of work required for this position are 35 to 40 hours per week, with occasional early evening hours for team meetings, as the manager is located in our Redwood City office in California.

title: Senior Manager, Corporate Strategy & Development (all genders)
description:
The role

As a Senior Manager, Corporate Strategy & Development, you will work in a small, AI enabled team of highly driven and committed individuals, reporting to the Director Corporate Strategy & Development. This is a high-exposure role, acting as the strategic and analytical engine for our most important decisions in a team that reports directly to the Group CEO.

You will work across the team's full agenda: Group and business unit strategy, portfolio and capital allocation decisions, and M&A. You are hands-on: you build the financial models, analysis and executive-level outputs yourself. You work under the guidance of the team leadership, owning the quality of analysis and models within your workstreams as well as the respective internal stakeholder relationships.

What you’ll do

  • Corporate Strategy: Support the development of the Group's mid-term strategy by driving the process, own the underlying analysis, strategic synthesis, and preparation of strategic documents.
  • Business Unit Strategy: Act as an internal consultant, supporting our key business units across geographies on a project-by-project basis to develop their mid-term strategies and solve their most complex challenges.
  • M&A Strategy: Drive workstreams for M&A projects, building and owning financial models, analyzing targets, preparing negotiations and supporting the M&A processes the team owns.
  • Portfolio Optimization: Contribute to the strategic analysis for key portfolio decisions, including potential geo-expansions, new vertical or brand launches or divestments.
  • Capital Allocation: Develop and improve the analytical frameworks and models to support our strategic budget allocation and ROI analysis.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience: 4+ years of high-performance experience from a top-tier Management Consulting firm, Investment Banking, or a comparable in-house Strategy / Corporate Development team.
  • Toolkit: Exceptional qualitative and analytical problem-solving skills. You are hypothesis-driven and can own and structure complex analytical problems from end-to-end. You are utilizing AI tools to meaningfully improve your productivity. Ability to build applications with AI coding tools is a plus.
  • Financial Acumen: Strong financial modeling skills are required: you have built and defended models used for investment or strategic decisions. Valuation experience is a plus. description:

  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Data Operations team at Stark builds and maintains the core data pipelines, sensor logging, and annotation workflows that feed our AI and perception models. Operating at the intersection of hardware testing, flight logs, and machine learning, the team ensures high-throughput, high-fidelity data availability. We work closely with ML Engineers, perception experts, and external labeling partners to scale training data for autonomous defence systems.

YOUR MISSION

You are the crucial bridge between our raw field data, our external labeling partners, and our internal Machine Learning teams. Your mission is to ensure our AI models are trained on the highest quality data possible. You will own the day-to-day operations of the data labeling lifecycle: curating raw data, preparing annotation batches, managing vendor communication, and rigorously assessing the quality of incoming labels. If you are highly organized, detail-oriented, and interested in the intersection of data operations and Computer Vision, this is the perfect place to start your career in AI.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Own the day-to-day data labeling lifecycle: curate raw field data, create annotation batches, and prepare deliveries for external labeling companies.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for external data annotation vendors, clarifying edge cases and providing feedback on labeling guidelines.
  • Conduct rigorous Quality Assurance (QA) assessments on incoming label deliveries, track error rates, and create performance reports.
  • Support data curation efforts, filtering and selecting the most valuable sensor data (images, video, lidar) for model training.
  • Work closely with ML Engineers to understand their data needs, edge cases, and specific Computer Vision requirements.
  • Help maintain the data catalog by ensuring incoming datasets are properly tagged and logged.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented: you can manage multiple data batches, vendor deliveries, and QA processes simultaneously without dropping the ball.
  • Strong communication skills: you are comfortable coordinating with external vendors and writing clear, unambiguous instructions/guidelines.
  • Basic understanding of Computer Vision and Machine Learning concepts (e.g., bounding boxes, segmentation masks, object tracking).
  • Comfortable with basic scripting (Python) and data querying (SQL) to automate small tasks or filter data batches.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver who enjoys bringing order to chaotic data deliveries.
  • Fluent in English.

description:
Über AlixPartners

Expertise, Umsetzungsstärke, Verantwortung – AlixPartners steht für messbare Ergebnisse „when it really matters“. Als global agierende Unternehmensberatung helfen wir unseren Klienten dabei, schnell und entschlossen auf ihre wichtigsten Herausforderungen zu reagieren. Unsere erfahrenen Beraterinnen und Berater sind spezialisiert darauf, Unternehmenswerte zu schaffen, zu schützen und wiederherzustellen. Vom „manager magazin“ und der Wissenschaftlichen Gesellschaft für Management & Beratung (WGMB) wurde AlixPartners 2023 als umsetzungsstärkstes Beratungsunternehmen ausgezeichnet. Seit über 40 Jahren unterstützt AlixPartners seine Klienten – mit inzwischen knapp 4000 MitarbeiterInnen in 27 Büros weltweit.

Unser Angebot

Wirkungsvoll, hands-on und pragmatisch: Bei AlixPartners treibt Ihre Leidenschaft Ihre Karriere – durch hohe Leistung, Initiative und Resultate. Gemeinsam mit sehr erfahrenen Teammitgliedern werden Sie in kleinen Teams, Seite an Seite mit Eigentümer:innen, Vorstandsmitgliedern und Senior Management zusammenarbeiten. Sie liefern schnell umsetzbare Lösungen für dringende Fragestellungen, oft in (zeit-) kritischen Situationen, bei denen viel auf dem Spiel steht.

Durch unseren One-Firm Firm Ansatz bieten wir länderübergreifende Möglichkeiten für Weiterbildung sowie zur persönlichen und professionellen Entwicklung.

Außerdem erwartet Sie ein attraktives Gehaltspaket mit umfassenden Benefits und zahlreiche Initiativen unserer Employer Resource Groups – sprechen Sie uns gerne darauf an.

Business Management Consulting:

  • Als AI & Data Consultant werden Sie eine Schlüsselrolle spielen, indem Sie nicht nur die Geschäftsabläufe unserer Kunden optimieren, sondern auch zukunftsweisende KI-Strategien entwerfen, welche die Wettbewerbsposition unserer Kunden dauerhaft verbessern.
  • Sie übersetzen komplexe Geschäftsprobleme in umsetzbare Technologiekonzepte und präsentieren wichtige Erkenntnisse und Lösungen auf Managementebene.

Data and Technology:

  • Extrahierung, Verarbeitung und Analyse von Daten aus einer Vielzahl von strukturierten und unstrukturierten Unternehmensquellen, Drittanbietern und öffentlich verfügbaren Daten.
  • Nutzung von Cloud-Datenverarbeitungs-Frameworks wie Apache Spark, Databricks o.ä. zur Verarbeitung und Analyse komplexer, großer Datenmengen.
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit der Nutzung von Cloud-Produkten und -Lösungen über APIs, insbesondere MS Azure und AWS.
  • Entwurf mehrstufiger Datenpipelines, die skriptgesteuerte Transformationen und API-Aufrufe zu verschiedenen Diensten kombinieren.

Data Science:

  • Einsatz von Python oder R zur Analyse und Modellierung komplexer und umfangreicher Daten.
  • Entwicklung und Anwendung von Modellen für Clustering, Klassifikation, Regression, Anomalieerkennung, natürliche Sprachverarbeitung oder GenAI.
  • Erstellung von KI-Modellen, Algorithmen und Anwendungen sowie Integration der entwickelten KI-Lösungen in bestehende Geschäftsprozesse.
  • Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Berichten und Visualisierungen, die Ergebnisse klar, prägnant und ansprechend darstellen und dabei den Geschäftszielen und zentralen analytischen Fragestellungen entsprechen.
  • Verständliche Vermittlung technischer Ansätze, Implementierungen und Ergebnisse an ein nicht-technisches Publikum.

Ihr Profil

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre relevante Berufs- oder Beratungserfahrung, idealerweise in der Management- oder IT-Beratung.
  • Problemlösungsorientierte, unternehmerische und stark analytische Persönlichkeit sowie hervorragende Kommunikations- und Interaktionsfähigkeiten.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Nutzung datenbasierter Analysen zur Entwicklung von Strategien und zur Verbesserung der Unternehmensleistung.
  • Tiefgehende Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Daten und Technologien sowie einer oder mehreren datenorientierten Programmiersprachen wie SQL, Python, R.
  • Erfahrung mit allgemeinen Programmiersprachen wie Java, C++, Rust, Go, JavaScript ist von Vorteil.
  • Hervorragende akademische Qualifikationen: Master, Diplom, PhD oder vergleichbarer Abschluss.
  • Verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und Englisch, weitere Fremdsprachen sind von Vorteil.
  • Hohe Reisebereitschaft – hybrides Reisemodell, Standort ist dabei frei wählbar.
  • Arbeitserlaubnis, die Reisen und Arbeit innerhalb der EU ermöglicht.

description: Location: Chancery Lane, London (Office-based 4 days) The Mission At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution. We are looking for a Product Lead who operates like a Staff PM: someone who owns our most important product bets end-to-end, from ambiguous problem space to shipped outcome. You combine sharp product judgment with hands-on discovery skills, and you measure yourself on commercial impact, not output. We're not looking for someone to write specs and manage a backlog. We want someone who helps us think better, decide better, and ship better. The goal isn't more process, it's higher quality decisions made faster. You will work directly with our Head of Product, CTO, founders and senior engineers to shape what we build and why. What you will own You will not hand anything over. You will own the bet from first insight to shipped impact. Own discovery through delivery for our most important product bets, from early ambiguity to validated direction to launched product Work directly with engineers and founders from the start of any initiative as the accountable product owner, not a coordinator Frame the problem, define the hypothesis, and choose the fastest route to signal: interviews, prototypes, fake doors, experiments, or just shipping and measuring Translate messy qualitative and quantitative signals into clear product direction, then drive that direction through to execution Set success metrics, make the call on when there's enough signal to build, and own the outcome either way Embed structured learning loops into how we operate so insight compounds over time Raise the bar of product thinking across the team: coach others, introduce lightweight frameworks, and get the whole company closer to customers Who you are You are a full-stack product thinker. Outcome owner: You connect user behaviour to funnels, retention, and revenue. You think in bets and expected value, not feature lists, and you hold yourself accountable to results. Discovery-strong: Genuinely fluent across qualitative research, behavioural insight, and experimentation. You generate strong signal quickly and pick the right method for the decision at hand, rather than outsourcing the thinking. Engineering partner: You work shoulder to shoulder with engineers, translating insight into crisp problem framing and practical tradeoffs. Engineers want to work with you because you make the work clearer, not slower. Decision oriented: You know when there's enough signal to move. You sharpen hypotheses, clarify thinking, and make confident calls under uncertainty. You'd rather ship and learn than perfect and wait. Force multiplier: Your impact shows up in how the whole team operates. You build repeatable systems for discovery and decision-making that outlast any single project. The Mission

At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution.

You combine sharp product judgment with hands-on discovery skills, and you measure yourself on commercial impact, not output.

We're not looking for someone to write specs and manage a backlog. We want someone who helps us think better, decide better, and ship better. The goal isn't more process, it's higher quality decisions made faster.

You will work directly with our Head of Product, CTO, founders and senior engineers to shape what we build and why.

What you will own

You will not hand anything over. You will own the bet from first insight to shipped impact.

  • Own discovery through delivery for our most important product bets, from early ambiguity to validated direction to launched product

  • Work directly with engineers and founders from the start of any initiative as the accountable product owner, not a coordinator

  • Frame the problem, define the hypothesis, and choose the fastest route to signal: interviews, prototypes, fake doors, experiments, or just shipping and measuring

  • Translate messy qualitative and quantitative signals into clear product direction, then drive that direction through to execution

  • Set success metrics, make the call on when there's enough signal to build, and own the outcome either way

  • Embed structured learning loops into how we operate so insight compounds over time

  • Raise the bar of product thinking across the team: coach others, introduce lightweight frameworks, and get the whole company closer to customers

Who you are

You are a full-stack product thinker.

  • Outcome owner: You connect user behaviour to funnels, retention, and revenue. You think in bets and expected value, not feature lists, and you hold yourself accountable to results.

  • Discovery-strong: Genuinely fluent across qualitative research, behavioural insight, and experimentation. You generate strong signal quickly and pick the right method for the decision at hand, rather than outsourcing the thinking.

  • Engineering partner: You work shoulder to shoulder with engineers, translating insight into crisp problem framing and practical tradeoffs. Engineers want to work with you because you make the work clearer, not slower.

  • Decision oriented: You know when there's enough signal to move. You sharpen hypotheses, clarify thinking, and make confident calls under uncertainty. You'd rather ship and learn than perfect and wait.

  • Force multiplier: Your impact shows up in how the whole team operates. You build repeatable systems for discovery and decision-making that outlast any single project.

You will be the senior product voice on our most important initiatives, working directly with the Head of Product, CPGO, founders, and senior engineers. This is not a support function. You will be embedded in high impact work from day one, with real authority over what we build and why.

You will operate at speed. We care about generating signal quickly, making informed decisions, and shipping fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening your thinking as you go.

You will move fluidly across the full product lifecycle. Some weeks you will be deep in user interviews or pressure testing a major bet, other weeks you will be in the detail with engineers getting something over the line.

You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes.

If there are specific tools you believe are critical to moving faster or generating better signal, we will support that. We want you to design the right setup, not work around constraints.

Why Fyxer?

We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.

  • Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

title: CENTRALE LYON - Ingénieur informatique / EDA – Qualification d’outils, modèles et IP
description: Présentation département L’Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon (INL) a pour vocation de développer des recherches technologiques multidisciplinaires dans le domaine des micro et nanotechnologies et de leurs applications. Les recherches menées s’étendent des matériaux aux systèmes. Le laboratoire s’appuie sur la plate-forme technologique lyonnaise Nanolyon. Les domaines d’application couvrent de grands secteurs économiques : l’industrie des semiconducteurs, les technologies de l’information, les technologies du vivant et de la santé, l’énergie et l’environnement. Le laboratoire est multi sites avec des localisations sur les campus d’Ecully et de Lyon-Tech La Doua. Il regroupe environ 240 personnes dont 120 personnels permanents. L’INL est un acteur majeur du Pôle de Recherche et d’Enseignement. Ce poste se situe dans un environnement innovant, à la pointe des technologies du futur, dans des secteurs stratégiques applicatifs. Le poste se situe dans un secteur relevant de la protection du potentiel scientifique et technique (PPST), et nécessite donc, conformément à la réglementation, que votre arrivée soit autorisée par l'autorité compétente du MESR Présentation de la ou les thématiques : Le programme PHOENIX est un projet national d’envergure (17 M€, 5 ans) financé par France 2030 et visant à structurer un hub français pour la conception de circuits intégrés, incluant les chiplets et les méthodes d’EDA enrichies par l’IA. title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-Doctoral Position Ferroelectric-Based Ternary Computing: From Circuit Design to System-Level Integration Scientific Context
description: Energy efficiency remains one of the foremost challenges in modern computing, spanning from edge IoT devices to high-performance data centers. Conventional CMOS-based architectures are approaching fundamental physical limits, while the "memory wall" — data transfers between processor and memory accounting for 70 to 90% of total system energy — continues to worsen with the ever-growing demands of data-intensive workloads such as deep neural networks and signal processing pipelines. In-Memory Computing (IMC) has emerged as a disruptive paradigm to overcome these bottlenecks by embedding arithmetic operations directly within memory arrays, drastically reducing data movement. In this landscape, ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) stand out as particularly compelling devices: fully compatible with standard CMOS fabrication processes, non-volatile, reconfigurable, and capable of storing intermediate polarization states — a property that naturally enables ternary logic within a single device. The Post-Doctoral position will cover at least one of the following tasks: Design Standard Cell Technology Library based on FeFET devices developed at INL in order to be used with synthesis flow. Design and optimize ternary arithmetic units (multiply-accumulate units, adders, comparators) based on the FeFET ternary gate library developed within the project, targeting area, power, and timing closure under realistic process constraints. Develop and refine system-level models of FeFET-based ternary IMC units, abstracting circuit-level characterization results into architecture simulators, enabling design space exploration across the full heterogeneous system. Investigate hardware/software co-design strategies for mapping real-world applications — particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and signal processing kernels — onto the ternary IMC fabric, exploiting approximate computing techniques to trade precision for energy efficiency. Assess and benchmark the energy, performance, and accuracy trade-offs of ternary IMC against binary CMOS and binary NVM-based IMC reference implementations, using both synthetic benchmarks and real application workloads. Contribute to the definition of a design methodology for ternary ferroelectric circuits, including EDA tool flows, cell library characterization guidelines, and design rules, with the aim of enabling broader community adoption. Required Candidate Profile The ideal candidate holds a PhD in microelectronics, computer architecture, or a closely related field , and demonstrates at least one of the following hard skills: Circuit and architecture design: Strong expertise in digital circuit design flows and computer architecture, with hands-on experience using industrial EDA tools (Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre, Synopsys). Experience with standard-cell library characterization is a plus. Emerging memory technologies: Solid knowledge of non-volatile memory devices, preferably including ferroelectric materials (FeFET, FeCap) or resistive memories (RRAM, PCM). Familiarity with compact modeling is an asset. System-level design and simulation: Experience with architecture-level simulation frameworks and hardware/software co-design methodologies. Knowledge of RISC-V ecosystems is a plus. Application domains: Familiarity with deep neural network inference workloads and/or digital signal processing pipelines, particularly in the context of approximate or energy-constrained computing. Programming: Proficiency in HDL (Verilog, VHDL, Verilog-A) and scripting languages (Python, Shell) for design automation and simulation. Soft skills: Scientific leadership, ability to coordinate with PhD students and international partners, strong publication record consistent with career stage, and excellent written and oral communication in English. Language: Fluent scientific English is mandatory. French is not required but is welcome. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Government's hardest missions increasingly require insight across institutional boundaries, without requiring those institutions, their accountability, or their data to be centralised. The opportunity isn't one giant government data system; it's enabling institutions to connect, govern and use data and insight across boundaries while retaining control of their own data, responsibilities and decisions. What We Look For

description:
Your mission

You will bring accounting in-house at SPARETECH, globally, for our German GmbH and our US Inc. You will be hands-on with bookkeeping, revenue recognition, and consolidation, and you will strategically move them onto one scalable global Accounting solution.

As our business grows, you will make sure our accounting is accurate, high quality, and compliant with German and US requirements, giving SPARETECH a reliable financial foundation for every next step.

We offer you the opportunity to  

  • Build from the ground up: Bring accounting in-house from external advisors and set up a function that scales with the business.
  • Own accounting globally: Take full responsibility for bookkeeping, month-end close, and annual financial statements for our German and US entities.
  • Run the core processes: Own revenue recognition, purchase-to-pay, and order-to-cash accounting, as well as correct balance sheet bookings and asset tracking.
  • Bring the group together: Design and run a clear consolidation process across both entities.
  • Choose the tools: Select and roll out a scalable global accounting and consolidation solution, building on today's setup of DATEV in Germany and NetSuite in the US.
  • Partner with experts: Work with our tax advisors and with auditors as the go-to person for accounting.
  • Grow fast: Take on new challenges as our business, products, and reporting requirements grow, with a steep learning curve.
  • Work your way: Work fully remote from anywhere in Germany, in close collaboration with our VP Finance and a small, hands-on finance team.

Become part of our team if you 

  • Bring experience: Have ideally 3 to 8 years of accounting experience, including accounting in a startup. Experience at a Big 4 or mid-tier audit firm is a plus.
  • Know German GAAP: Have strong knowledge of German GAAP (HGB), including experience with consolidation.
  • Understand SaaS revenue: Have experience with revenue recognition in a SaaS or subscription business.
  • Have a solid foundation: Hold a university degree in accounting, finance, or business. A professional qualification such as ACCA or CPA is a plus.
  • Add an international view: Bring knowledge of US accounting standards (US GAAP), or experience with DATEV, NetSuite, or implementing accounting software. Each is a plus.
  • Automate where it counts: Look for ways to automate processes, including with AI tools.
  • Like to get hands-on: Enjoy making the bookings yourself while keeping the bigger picture in view.
  • Take ownership: Work independently, stay pragmatic and solution-oriented in a scaling company, and enjoy building processes from scratch.
  • Keep growing: Are eager to learn and constantly seek new challenges.
  • Speak fluently: Are fluent in German and English.

You can expect 

  • A remote-yes company, where you can decide every day whether you work from home, at our Stuttgart or Munich office, or at any Design Office in Germany.
  • A permanent employment contract, 30 days of vacation, and the opportunity to participate in the company's success through our VSOP program.
  • Modern hardware and the frame for a height-adjustable desk.
  • An annual training budget of 1000€ for your professional development.
  • A subsidized job bike to escape city traffic and a Wellpass gym membership to stay active.
  • To enjoy Corporate Benefits, including discounts on fashion, travel, and much more from various companies.
  • A dynamic start-up atmosphere and an international team in which new ideas, creative approaches, and cooperation at eye level are valued.

About SPARETECH

SPARETECH's vision is to empower the zero-waste industrial sharing economy by enabling maintenance and procurement teams at manufacturing leaders like Bosch, Porsche, and Nestlé to reduce MRO spend and optimize inventory through accurate part information, internal transparency, and market visibility.

To achieve this, we have built, and continue to build, an AI-powered MRO software that connects all players in the spare parts ecosystem, from manufacturers and suppliers to the people working behind the machines. By facilitating the exchange of data, knowledge, and expertise, we create shared visibility that empowers smarter decisions, reduces waste, and drives seamless collaboration. This connected spare parts intelligence unlocks value that extends far beyond software.

Backed by Insight Partners, SPARETECH is accelerating its growth with a strong focus on product innovation and team excellence. We take pride in our inclusive and collaborative culture, as well as our energetic and committed team.

  • Directly located and available to work in Germany;

WE OFFER

  • Lease bike options / JobRad and 25% subsidy for the Deutschlandticket;
  • Occasional breakfast/lunch at the office, Smoothie Tuesdays;

  • Future Bens - Exclusive access to sustainable, healthy products at attractive deals;
  • Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform;
  • Social events, plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues through organised activities and celebrations;
  • A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021 and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards;
  • Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!
  • The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.

 

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

title: Sales Engineering Manager Core - Mainland Europe
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in Mainland Europe (DACH & France). You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our Sales Engineering team is full of problem solvers and tinkerers who are not afraid to get their hands dirty (literally) and play a critical role in demonstrating and communicating the value of Samsara’s platform with our largest customers.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and inspired to go farther than you have before. 
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will: 

  • Manage individual and team performance ensuring our partnership with sales, product, support, and customer success teams are productive and efficient
  • Work with Account Executives and Regional Sales Directors on account planning, strategy, and sales call activity
  • Manage escalations (product issues, feature requests, etc.) in a pre-sales environment
  • Participate in customer/prospect calls as a trusted advisor
  • Partner with other Sales Engineering leaders to improve the overall Sales Engineering organization at Samsara

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • B.S. degree in Computer Science or similar
  • 5+ years of sales engineering management experience
  • Experience with Software Product sales: Infrastructure, SaaS
  • Knowledge in one or more of these areas of expertise: IoT, Networking / Security, SaaS, Cloud Technologies, or Physical Security
  • Strong technical and business acumen
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills 
  • Ability to partner with a broad coalition of stakeholders, ranging from sales, product, marketing, support, and customer success, and from individual contributors to executive team members across the organization
  • Demonstrated leadership, creativity, and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent presentation and organizational skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment
  • Ability to travel as needed
  • Location: Remote, Germany or Remote, France 
  • Language requirement: Fluent German or Fluent French 

 

 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Sales Engineering Manager Core - UK&I
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in the UKI. You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our Sales Engineering team is full of problem solvers and tinkerers who are not afraid to get their hands dirty (literally) and play a critical role in demonstrating and communicating the value of Samsara’s platform with our largest customers.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and inspired to go farther than you have before. 
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will: 

  • Manage individual and team performance ensuring our partnership with sales, product, support, and customer success teams are productive and efficient
  • Work with Account Executives and Regional Sales Directors on account planning, strategy, and sales call activity
  • Manage escalations (product issues, feature requests, etc.) in a pre-sales environment
  • Participate in customer/prospect calls as a trusted advisor
  • Partner with other Sales Engineering leaders to improve the overall Sales Engineering organization at Samsara

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • B.S. degree in Computer Science or similar
  • 5+ years of sales engineering management experience
  • Experience with Software Product sales: Infrastructure, SaaS
  • Knowledge in one or more of these areas of expertise: IoT, Networking / Security, SaaS, Cloud Technologies, or Physical Security
  • Strong technical and business acumen
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills 
  • Ability to partner with a broad coalition of stakeholders, ranging from sales, product, marketing, support, and customer success, and from individual contributors to executive team members across the organization
  • Demonstrated leadership, creativity, and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent presentation and organizational skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment
  • Ability to travel as needed
  • Location: Remote, United Kingdom

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

description: ZEAL Network SE is a dynamic, international group of companies that has been creating exciting and innovative lottery experiences for over 20 years. As Germany’s largest provider of online lotteries through our brands LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, the second-largest national lottery, we’re shaping the future of the lottery industry. We are passionate about driving innovation, as demonstrated by our newest brands, Freiheit+ and Traumhausverlosung, which bring fresh and exciting dreams to life. Additionally, through ZEAL Ventures, we invest in inspiring e-commerce start-ups like Omaze and DAYMADE, fueling fresh ideas and opportunities. Our team of 350+ professionals from diverse backgrounds is united by a visionary mindset, a passion for collaboration, and a commitment to inspire dreams. At ZEAL, we empower our people to think ambitiously and work together toward a shared purpose: helping people imagine and achieve their aspirations. The Role As our Android Developer, you will join one of our cross-functional domain teams and help shape the future of our digital lottery experiences across platforms. You will play a key role in evolving our Android app, by implementing cutting-edge features with Jetpack Compose, and creating accessible experience that millions of customers trust. At the same time, our domain teams take end-to-end ownership of the customer experience across Android, iOS, and web. We believe great developers are curious beyond the boundaries of a single platform. You’ll therefore have the opportunity and willingness to contribute to our Angular/TypeScript based webshop and Swift based iOS app, collaborating closely with engineers across technologies to deliver the best solution for our customers. Your Tasks Develop and maintain 5-star Android applications that are high-quality, efficient, scalable, and accessible. Take ownership of the Android development lifecycle, including planning, implementation, testing, release, and monitoring. Work as part of a holistic domain team that owns customer experiences across web, Android, and iOS, collaborating closely with engineers across all three platforms as well as backend developers. Contribute beyond Android when needed, particularly to our Angular/TypeScript-based webshop, and be open to learning and working across our frontend technology stack. Collaborate on technical solutions at a domain level rather than optimizing for a single platform, helping create consistent and seamless customer experiences. Manage Android app releases and monitor performance through Firebase, ensuring excellent quality, responsiveness, and reliability. Stay ahead of developments in the Android ecosystem and bring relevant technologies, patterns, and ideas into the team. Share your Android expertise with the wider team through code reviews, technical guidance, pair programming, and strong engineering practices. Learn from colleagues with expertise in web, iOS, and backend development and actively contribute to a culture of shared ownership and knowledge exchange. What you offer us: You are an experienced Android Developer who enjoys working in a cross-functional environment and wants to take ownership of products beyond the boundaries of a single platform. You bring at least 3 years of hands-on experience with Kotlin, the Android SDK, and widely used Jetpack libraries. You have experience with Jetpack Compose and modern Android development practices. You demonstrate expertise in structuring code using established design patterns and architectural approaches such as Clean Architecture and MVVM. You are proficient in writing testable code as well as Unit, Integration, and UI tests. You are skilled in working with RESTful APIs, JSON, and web service integrations. You are familiar with modern development and CI/CD pipelines and tools, including GitHub Actions. You bring a strong analytical mindset with advanced debugging and problem-solving abilities. You have a solid understanding of best-practice UX principles and a keen eye for design details, including UI placement, layouts, and interaction patterns. You are curious about technologies outside the Android ecosystem and are comfortable contributing to web development with TypeScript and Angular. Previous professional experience with these technologies is a plus, but a willingness to learn and contribute is essential. You enjoy sharing your expertise while also learning from engineers specializing in other platforms and technologies. You have good verbal and written communication skills in English. Proficiency in German or a willingness to learn the language is a plus. What we offer: State-of-the-art technologies and an agile environment (Check our Tech Radar: https://lotto24.github.io/tech-radar/ ) A modern, dynamic culture grounded in the success of a leading-edge e-commerce company. A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact. Ongoing personal growth, supported by an annual development budget of €1,500 to invest in your professional development. Trust and autonomy, no micromanagement, just confidence in your ability to deliver and excel. Flexible work options with a hybrid setup focused on results. Unlimited vacation days in addition to your yearly 30-day vacation allowance. Opportunity for workations abroad using our WorkFlex tool. Monthly mobility allowance of €30 to use on the mobility option of your choice (e.g., the Deutschlandticket), plus access to a company bike leasing program. Company pension scheme, provided in partnership with Degura, to support your future financial security. Subsidized EGYM WELLPASS membership, with a contribution of only €25 per month, giving you access to a wide range of gyms and sports options across Germany.
