title: Senior Solution Consultant
description:
About Rimes

Rimes provides the Intelligence Fabric for Capital Markets, a trusted data network and intelligence architecture that transforms fragmented data, operations and workflows into decision-grade intelligence. The world’s leading institutional investors, asset managers, and service providers rely on Rimes to help them make better investment decisions that power more than US$ 75 trillion in AUM annually.

A Senior Solution Consultant at Rimes is a recognized functional expert who leads workstreams and initiatives across client engagements. You have firm, working knowledge of your domain both from a business and technical perspective and you use that expertise to own outcomes, not just tasks. You are self-managing: you set your own priorities within agreed project objectives, manage your stakeholders without prompting, and lead the consultants working alongside you. You bring a strategic lens to your engagements, identifying what is not being asked as well as what is and you are trusted to represent Rimes' capabilities in complex client environments independently.

Rimes Professional Services is the change agent that enables clients to unlock value from Rimes' data management, benchmarking, and platform services. The Solution Consulting team sits at the heart of PS spanning the full client engagement lifecycle from initial scoping and requirements discovery through to solution design, delivery, validation, and adoption The Consulting function operates across three primary product tracks self-serviced Data Management and Investment Intelligence, Rimes-serviced Data Management, and Benchmarks & Indices (B&I) each with its own delivery model, which is reflected throughout this job description.

WHAT WILL YOU DO: 

Client Engagement & Requirements

  • Lead requirements discovery across complex, multi-workstream engagements, including facilitated workshops with senior client stakeholders
  • Interpret ambiguous or conflicting requirements, identifying the underlying need and guiding clients towards solutions that address it
  • Manage scope proactively — identifying scope creep, influencing clients towards pragmatic approaches, and ensuring changes are managed formally
  • Act as the primary Rimes consulting point of contact for your assigned client workstreams

Solution Design & Advisory

  • Design and own solution approaches for complex client use cases, covering multiple asset classes and data domains
  • Lead solution design sessions and client workshops, facilitating effective engagement and clear decision-making
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve client processes and expand the value Rimes delivers beyond the immediate project scope
  • Challenge non-standard client approaches confidently and constructively, backed by evidence and comparable engagement experience
  • Review and quality-assure solution designs and documentation produced by Solution Consultants on your team

Delivery & Team Leadership

  • Own delivery outcomes across your assigned workstreams, taking accountability for the quality and timeliness of your team's contribution
  • Anticipate and actively manage delivery risks; escalate promptly when senior involvement is required
  • Mentor and guide Solution Consultants working alongside you — reviewing outputs, providing constructive feedback, and helping them develop their capability
  • Collaborate cross-functionally across Professional Services, Product and Engineering teams as needed to drive delivery

Validation, Adoption & Practice Development

  • Lead UAT planning and execution, defining acceptance criteria and managing client engagement through the testing cycle
  • Guide clients through technology change, identifying adoption risks and addressing them proactively
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of PS best practices, delivery standards, and methodologies
  • Provide structured feedback to Product teams on client needs, product gaps, and field observations

General Delivery and Change

  • Support change beyond formal project delivery where required, including smaller client change, post-deployment enhancements, defects and transition activity, applying your expertise to understand the need, shape the appropriate solution and support it through to a successful outcome.
  • Support wider Professional Services and Rimes priorities as required, including internal projects, change initiatives and activities aligned to company and functional OKRs, contributing your expertise wherever it can add value.

AI & Innovation

  • Lead adoption of AI-enabled workflows within your engagements, identifying where new tooling can accelerate delivery or improve quality
  • Contribute to team capability-building by sharing effective AI workflow practices with less experienced colleagues
  • Stay actively current with evolving AI capabilities relevant to your product track

Qualifications and Desired Experience

  • Deep working knowledge of investment management, asset management, or financial data operations across multiple domains (e.g. equities, fixed income, alternatives, derivatives)
  • Strong understanding of data management workflows and technical considerations relevant to the product track
  • Demonstrated experience leading client-facing solutioning and delivery on complex, multi-workstream engagements
  • Experience mentoring or guiding more junior practitioners in a consulting or delivery environment
  • Familiarity with Rimes products or deep experience with comparable data management or benchmarking platforms

Skills

  • Ability to lead complex solution design and translate it into actionable, well-communicated delivery plans
  • Strong stakeholder management — able to influence at project and operational level without formal authority
  • Clear communication across operational, project, and senior client audiences — able to calibrate message to audience
  • Comfortable managing competing priorities across multiple workstreams independently
  • Constructive challenge — advocating for best practices diplomatically while maintaining client relationships

Key Attributes

  • Accountable for outcomes, not just tasks and takes ownership of what the team delivers
  • Self-managing: sets priorities, manages stakeholders, and escalates proactively without being prompted
  • A natural informal leader and mentor and invests time in developing the consultants around them
  • Brings a strategic perspective and sees what is not being asked as well as what is
  • Consistently models the professional standards in the PS Consulting Excellence Framework

Only selected candidates will be contacted for interviews. We appreciate your understanding. Thank you for considering a career with us.

title: Senior Technical Architect (Privacy)
description:
Strength in Trust 

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

We are looking for a Senior Technical Architect (Privacy) to join our Technical Advisory team (part of Customer Success). This is a customer-facing role for someone who combines a strong technical foundation with attention to details, and the ability to build trust with customers.

You will work with privacy, legal, compliance, and technology stakeholders to understand business objectives and challenges, assess maturity and platform adoption, and provide clear recommendations across privacy processes, operating models, workflows, data, and integrations. You will act as a trusted advisor and product expert without owning hands-on implementation or configuration.

Previous privacy or OneTrust expertise is valuable, but it is not the defining requirement for this role. We are looking for someone with the attitude, consultancy skills, and technical capability to learn the privacy domain quickly and become a trusted advisor.

Your Mission

  • Lead outcome-focused discovery, advisory engagements, workshops, and expert sessions with customers.
  • Clarify customer objectives, constraints, stakeholders, and desired outcomes before recommending a path forward.
  • Translate business and regulatory needs into practical recommendations for privacy processes, workflows, data, integrations, and OneTrust capabilities.
  • Explain solution options, dependencies, trade-offs, and implications for scale at the appropriate level of detail.
  • Assess customer readiness, adoption barriers, process maturity, and solution direction; recommend pragmatic next steps.
  • Create clear, decision-ready deliverables such as current-state assessments, future-state recommendations, reference architectures, process guidance, and reusable patterns.
  • Build trusted relationships and communicate confidently with both technical and executive audiences.
  • Partner closely with Customer Success, Product, Sales, Support, Professional Services, and other specialist teams to deliver consistent customer outcomes.
  • Capture recurring customer needs and translate them into feedback, enablement content, playbooks, and product opportunities.
  • Maintain clear advisory boundaries: provide strategic framing, product expertise, and guidance while enabling customers or delivery partners to execute implementation.

You Are 

Your Experience Includes:

  • 5+ years of experience in consulting, technical advisory, solution consulting, customer success, business analysis, transformation, or another customer-facing problem-solving role.
  • A strong technical background in enterprise software (ideally SaaS), systems, data, workflow design, integrations, APIs, solution architecture, or a related field.
  • A consultative approach: you listen carefully, ask effective questions, structure ambiguity, and turn complex problems into clear recommendations.
  • Strong learning agility and a constructive attitude, including curiosity, ownership, humility, resilience, and openness to feedback.
  • The ability to connect customer objectives to practical technology and operating-model decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt the message for executive, functional, and technical audiences.
  • Independent but also a team player
  • Experience influencing stakeholders and collaborating across functions without direct authority.
  • BA/BS in a related subject is required

Extra Impressive:

  • Experience in privacy, data protection, privacy operations, privacy technology, or a closely related field.
  • Experience with OneTrust Privacy Automation or comparable privacy-management platforms.
  • Familiarity with privacy regulations and frameworks
  • OneTrust certifications or relevant privacy credentials such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT
  • Experience advising enterprise customers on adoption, optimization, governance, or value realization.
  • Experience creating reusable advisory playbooks, reference architectures, or enablement materials.
  • Experience in using software for reporting and task management, such as Salesforce

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources  

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

  • OneTrust Careers on YouTube
  • @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

 

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an ----- email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from ----- Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a ----- email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to .

Our Commitment to You 

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career. 

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

title: Senior Director Sales Strategy & Operations (m/f/d)
description:
Help shape how AutoScout24 Group sells, serves its customers and drives commercial performance across international markets. 

Reporting to the CEO of Europe, you will lead around 20 colleagues across Commercial Program Management, Revenue Operations & CRM, and Sales Analytics. You will shape our commercial operating model, transform dealer interactions through AI and deliver strategic programs across functions and markets. Working through experienced team leads and closely collaborating with Country Managers, you will combine strategic thinking with people leadership and responsibility for ongoing operations. Your core remit is European, with global stakeholder interfaces. The team is predominantly based in Munich, making regular presence there important. 

What You Will Do 

  • Shape our commercial operating model: Improve sales, customer care, customer success and market steering. Partner with local leaders to define shared ways of working, meaningful KPIs and reporting that support commercial decisions across markets. 
  • Transform dealer interactions across sales and customer care with AI: Work with commercial, Product, Engineering and AI teams to identify valuable opportunities, guide experimentation and drive adoption of solutions that improve productivity, customer experience and commercial performance. 
  • Drive strategic projects and commercial programs: Turn complex challenges into clear programs with priorities, owners and success measures. Lead multidisciplinary initiatives across markets, connecting actions and operational inputs to commercial outcomes and staying accountable through implementation and adoption. 
  • Lead and develop your team leaders: Coach managers, develop talent and set clear priorities across a broad remit. Give specialist leaders direction and support while holding them accountable for delivery. 
  • Turn new products into commercial success: Lead commercial go-to-market planning and execution with Sales, Product, Product Marketing and Marketing, from preparation through launch and post-launch performance. 
  • Guide Revenue Operations and CRM: Set the agenda for Salesforce and the sales, customer care and billing processes it supports. Partner with specialist teams and Engineering to improve processes while keeping ongoing operations running reliably. 
  • Make data a stronger driver of decisions: Guide revenue and customer analytics, data governance and reliable data products. Help teams use dashboards and insights to understand performance and decide where to act. 
  • Build alignment across functions and markets: Understand local realities, challenge constructively and influence without direct authority. Communicate recommendations, progress and results clearly to senior management and shareholders. 

What You Bring 

  • Strong conceptual and analytical thinking: You structure ambiguous problems, use data to support decisions and identify the KPIs that matter. You combine this toolkit with sound commercial judgment, whether developed in management consulting or another demanding business environment. 
  • A track record of delivering complex projects: You have owned commercial programs or organisational change across functions and markets in an international matrix. You can show your personal contribution, how you secured adoption and the outcomes achieved. 
  • A solid understanding of commercial processes: You understand how initiatives and operational inputs drive customer and revenue outcomes. You are familiar with CRM and data-driven environments and can guide specialists in RevOps and analytics; deep technical expertise in Salesforce is not required. 
  • Experience managing managers: You have developed team leads, set priorities across competing demands and delivered through their teams. You bring the credibility to lead experienced specialists without needing to be the expert in every discipline. 
  • The ability to influence senior stakeholders: You build trust across functions and markets, understand local challenges and create commitment when priorities differ and colleagues do not report to you. 
  • Comfort with breadth and pace: You have worked in a complex, ambitious and fast-moving environment. You can switch between strategic programs, people leadership and ongoing operational responsibilities. Marketplace, classifieds or automotive experience can help, but is not essential. 
  • An interest in practical AI applications: You are motivated to improve sales and customer care through AI. Experience implementing AI solutions or leading related transformation is a plus. 
  • Excellent English communication and presentation skills: German and other European languages are helpful, but not required. 

What We Offer 

  • Benefits & flexibility: AutoScout24 offers benefits that allow our employees to work as freely and effectively as possible. We provide flexible office attendance and working hours, 30 days paid vacation and state-of-the-art, modern offices to name a few. Our goal is to support you in doing your best work. 
  • Diversity & inclusion: At AutoScout24 we appreciate different lifestyles and cultural backgrounds. We welcome diversity as a strength. We know that mixed teams work more successfully. Our organization is made up of more than 50+ different nationalities, all working together inclusively and respectfully. 

If this appeals to you, but you are in doubt about how exactly your skills match our requirements – we value personality, ambition, and an open mind. Don’t hesitate to get in touch and present your personal strengths to us.

description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment. Where 50 Billion Daily Predictions Begin The User Experience team is the origin point of adjoe Ads. Everything the system knows about a user, every prediction the ML models make, every bid placed in an auction. It all starts with code this team ships. The team owns two responsibilities. On the SDK side, a native Kotlin and Swift code runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. It participates in 120 million daily auctions , renders ad creatives across multiple formats, and captures the behavioral signals that power 50 billion predictions per day . The constraint that defines this work: you're executing inside someone else's app, on someone else's device, with zero tolerance for instability. Every ad impression has to feel native and fast to the user. On the analytics side, the dashboards, investigation tools, and data frameworks that turn raw data into decisions: real-time revenue performance across active campaigns, infrastructure cost visibility, and data quality assessments. If a number matters to the business or to engineering, this team makes it accessible. Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: Auction & Marketplace Analytics: You will monitor core ad exchange KPIs—including bid rates, win rates, timeout rates, eCPM, and render rates—and run deep dives to uncover bidding patterns and supply path optimization (SPO) opportunities. We are looking for someone with 2–3 years of experience as a Data or Product Analyst in AdTech (Programmatic, Ad Exchange, SSP, or DSP) who understands what drives marketplace health and revenue. A/B Testing & Revenue Strategy: You will design, track, and evaluate A/B tests for product features, floor pricing rules, and traffic shaping algorithms. We are looking for a data-driven thinker who loves solving business puzzles, testing commercial hypotheses, and proving what actually moves the needle on product performance. Advanced Data Extraction: You will query massive datasets to turn millions of raw ad events into clear business answers. We need advanced SQL skills to effortlessly query billions of rows, spot anomalies, and translate complex metrics into clear, actionable recommendations for our product and demand teams. Traffic & Cost Efficiency: You will analyze bid request data to identify inefficient traffic and help product managers design smart routing rules. We need an analyst who can balance top-line revenue with operational costs, finding ways to streamline traffic (Queries Per Second) without sacrificing publisher earnings. Executive Dashboarding & Reporting: You will build automated, easy-to-read dashboards that give Product, Engineering, and Demand Partnerships real-time visibility into campaign performance. We are looking for hands-on experience with BI tools like QuickSight, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or Redash to make key business numbers intuitive and accessible to everyone. Agile Project Execution: You will balance scheduled analytics projects with quick-turnaround deep dives when marketplace metrics shift unexpectedly. We need a hands-on, proactive analyst who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can independently manage multiple analytical priorities. 🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team. What’s in It for You? At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day. Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries. Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum. Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams. Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other. Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy. title: AI Engineer
description: About Us: Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. About the role: We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to build and run the agents at the heart of Tebi OS. You’ll design, ship, evaluate and scale our Product Agents, along with the data pipelines, tools and infrastructure that make them reliable in production. The ideal candidate started in data or ML engineering and has since moved into AI engineering, building LLM-powered agents for real users. You enjoy turning messy financial and operational data into context an agent can reason over and act on with confidence and you are passionate about solving product challenges through AI. You’ll work closely with product and engineering to put intelligence into the hands of hospitality teams. That could be an agent that answers questions about a restaurant’s finances in real time, one that automates repetitive back-office tasks, or internal tools that help us move faster. What you’ll do: Design, build and operate production agents: orchestration, tool and function calling, memory, multi-step reasoning, and integration with Tebi’s backend services Build the data foundations agents rely on, including real-time and batch pipelines over financial and operational data, retrieval layers, and well-modeled datasets agents can query safely and accurately Turn APIs and internal services into well-defined agent tools, and own the contracts between agents and the rest of the platform Set up evaluation for agent behavior: offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge and human review, regression testing on prompt and model changes, and feedback loops that improve agents over time Own observability for agents in production by tracing sessions, tool calls and model calls, and tracking latency, cost, error rates and quality Work with product teams to find where agents can meaningfully improve the customer experience or internal workflows, and say clearly where they can’t Make sure agents handle data securely and responsibly, with sensible guardrails, access controls, and protection against prompt injection and data leakage What you’ll bring: 7+ years in software engineering, with a solid base in data or ML engineering Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM agents to production, not just prototypes. You’ve dealt with flaky tool calls, runaway loops, hallucinated arguments and token budgets, and you have opinions on how to handle them. Strong data modeling and data warehousing fundamentals, plus experience with ingestion, transformation and data quality Strong SQL, and experience with pipeline tools (e.g. Airflow, dbt) and analytical or cloud data platforms (e.g. ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake) Experience evaluating and monitoring LLM systems, and an understanding of the full lifecycle from experiment to deployment to ongoing improvement Backend engineering skills: you’re comfortable building the API endpoint that exposes an agent’s output to the frontend, or the service an agent calls as a tool Clear communication, including the ability to explain trade-offs in latency, cost, accuracy and complexity to product partners A product mindset. You care about how your work lands with users, and you’re keen to meet customers face to face to understand their needs. This probably isn't the role for you if you have been working with AI agents to improve your day to day working flows but you haven’t built an Agent in the production. People who succeed at Tebi are independent, curious and passionate about hospitality. If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers . Benefits: Start-up Equity Competitive Salary Lunch Provided in Office Team building events Unlimited time off What is Restaurant Software? Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it. From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy. How we use AI at Tebi We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed. At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to build and run the agents at the heart of Tebi OS. You’ll design, ship, evaluate and scale our Product Agents, along with the data pipelines, tools and infrastructure that make them reliable in production.

The ideal candidate started in data or ML engineering and has since moved into AI engineering, building LLM-powered agents for real users. You enjoy turning messy financial and operational data into context an agent can reason over and act on with confidence and you are passionate about solving product challenges through AI.

You’ll work closely with product and engineering to put intelligence into the hands of hospitality teams. That could be an agent that answers questions about a restaurant’s finances in real time, one that automates repetitive back-office tasks, or internal tools that help us move faster.

What you’ll do:

  • Design, build and operate production agents: orchestration, tool and function calling, memory, multi-step reasoning, and integration with Tebi’s backend services

  • Build the data foundations agents rely on, including real-time and batch pipelines over financial and operational data, retrieval layers, and well-modeled datasets agents can query safely and accurately

  • Turn APIs and internal services into well-defined agent tools, and own the contracts between agents and the rest of the platform

  • Set up evaluation for agent behavior: offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge and human review, regression testing on prompt and model changes, and feedback loops that improve agents over time

  • Own observability for agents in production by tracing sessions, tool calls and model calls, and tracking latency, cost, error rates and quality

  • Work with product teams to find where agents can meaningfully improve the customer experience or internal workflows, and say clearly where they can’t

  • Make sure agents handle data securely and responsibly, with sensible guardrails, access controls, and protection against prompt injection and data leakage

What you’ll bring:

  • 7+ years in software engineering, with a solid base in data or ML engineering

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM agents to production, not just prototypes. You’ve dealt with flaky tool calls, runaway loops, hallucinated arguments and token budgets, and you have opinions on how to handle them.

  • Strong data modeling and data warehousing fundamentals, plus experience with ingestion, transformation and data quality

  • Strong SQL, and experience with pipeline tools (e.g. Airflow, dbt) and analytical or cloud data platforms (e.g. ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake)

  • Experience evaluating and monitoring LLM systems, and an understanding of the full lifecycle from experiment to deployment to ongoing improvement

  • Backend engineering skills: you’re comfortable building the API endpoint that exposes an agent’s output to the frontend, or the service an agent calls as a tool

  • Clear communication, including the ability to explain trade-offs in latency, cost, accuracy and complexity to product partners

  • A product mindset. You care about how your work lands with users, and you’re keen to meet customers face to face to understand their needs.

This probably isn't the role for you if you have been working with AI agents to improve your day to day working flows but you haven’t built an Agent in the production.

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Lunch Provided in Office

  • Team building events

  • Unlimited time off

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

raw.title: Senior Sales Engineer - MENA
raw.description:
Who we are:

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

Our culture:

  • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

  • We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless.

Location:

  • Remote MENA - Preference for Dubai

  • Please note: This role will require up to 50% travel.

 

About the role:

Sales Engineering is a team of subject matter experts who serve as the trusted technical advisor to prospective customers. You will lead prospects through the sales process by connecting their needs to Sardine’s value to win new customers and drive revenue growth. You will deliver best in class product demonstrations, fill out RFPs, and win over our prospective customer’s technical teams with your thought leadership and consultative approach. Internally, your insights from the field will help shape our product roadmap and will pave the way for future customers. You will play a key role in our commitment to customer excellence and allow Sardine to stay ahead of market trends.

The SE team is a high visibility and high impact team. At the intersection of our Go-To-Market and Product and Engineering teams, we serve as the link between our customer’s needs and the Sardine’s capabilities, ensuring our platform is always adding value to our customer’s Fraud and Compliance stack. It's a great role for someone who enjoys learning the intricacies of a product to drive value to prospects, and leading through innovative problem-solving to convert prospects into customers. Variety, ambiguity, innovation, and ownership of complex problems are all big components of this role.


What you'll be doing:

  • Support Account Executives in identifying a prospect’s fraud and compliance needs.

  • Prepare and deliver customized demos that showcase the impact of Sardine’s platform.

  • Interface with Security teams to articulate our security posture and successfully complete security reviews.

  • Complete RFPs for competitive opportunities.

  • Create comprehensive Solution Designs that address our prospect’s needs.

  • Collaborate with peers to improve all processes within the Sales Engineering team.

  • Work together with our product and engineering teams to identify areas for improvement in our product suite and help prioritize and design solutions.

 

What you’ll need:

  • 7+ years prior experience as a Sales Engineer, System Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or similar roles

  • Prior experience in similar roles within the Risk, Fraud, or Compliance domain

  • Experience with APIs, a strong understanding of JSON, and proficiency in one or more of the following languages: Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Go, or Java. Bonus points for knowledge of web development principles and/or the ability to build internal tools using one of these languages.

  • Strong analytical skills: you can dig into the technical details of a problem and turn it into a proposed solution

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced remote environment working with global clients

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical and business concepts to technical and non-technical personas.

Benefits we offer:

  • Generous compensation in cash and equity

  • Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested

  • Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture

  • Flexible paid time off and Year-end break

  • Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific

  • 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific

title: Senior AI Engineer, Location AI
description: Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. What you'll do This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands. At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area. In this role, you will: Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results. Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land. Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments. Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current. Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own. Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases. Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched. Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure. Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams. Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice. Some of the technical questions in this area are still open. You will help answer them. Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends. What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role Required Education/Certification: Bachelors Degree in STEM discipline and 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production ownership of services, pipelines, or SDKs. Technical Skills & Tools (Must-Haves): 2+ years shipping LLM-backed features to real users, in systems that carried error budgets, on-call rotations, and customers who noticed regressions. Data engineering depth: SQL, at least one distributed processing framework, and experience with pipelines where a wrong record mattered more than a slow one. Fluency with tool calling and agent orchestration, including the failure modes: stale context, hallucinated arguments, silent partial success, unbounded loops. Strong Python or TypeScript, and comfort reading code in whatever language the caller happens to be written in. Core Competencies & Scope: Direct experience or deep understanding of designing evaluations for non-deterministic systems. You can describe a dataset you built and the failure it caught. Working knowledge of more than one agent harness, and opinions about where each of them is weak. Experience diagnosing latency in a distributed request path. Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to ship something narrow that works while the general solution is still unclear. Nice to Have Traits for this Role Geospatial data experience: routing, geocoding, POI or address data, OpenStreetMap, or conflation of overlapping sources. Public API or SDK design experience, particularly for developers you never talk to. Experience building against MCP or similar tool transports. Experience running evals in CI, with a commercial harness or one you built. Automotive, in-vehicle infotainment, CarPlay, or Android Auto experience. Voice pipeline experience: streaming ASR, TTS, barge-in, endpointing, wake word. Work under constrained compute, offline, or intermittent connectivity. Experience operating a product through its first external integrations, where the customer finds the gaps before you do. Employment Requirements Employment Type : Full-time Weekly Hours : 40 h per week Location/Hybrid Policy : Remote (from any city in Germany) What We Value In addition to our core values , which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders: We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities. We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people. We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company. We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply. How we support you Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable. Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits. Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family. Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents. Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies. Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Non-US Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application. We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class. #LI-Remote Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Data Scientist — Data Cloud Acceleration
description:
WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.

About the team 

The Data Cloud Acceleration team identifies gaps and opportunities across clients and business units, then moves quickly to deliver practical new capabilities. We often develop and deploy the first version of a model, workflow, dataset, or application in days or weeks, learn from real usage, and improve it iteratively. 

We are business-minded technologists who care more about impact than technical novelty. We use sophisticated methods when the problem requires them and simpler approaches when they will deliver a better result faster. Our work should be predictable, demoable, trusted, reusable, measured, and amplified by AI. 

 

About the role 

The Senior Data Scientist will build models, analyses, and supporting ML components that improve business decisions, intelligence products, and client outcomes. You will independently own defined deliverables—from understanding the requirement and preparing the data through modeling, validation, documentation, and delivery. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will work across varied revenue and intelligence initiatives, often in partnership with a Lead Data Scientist, application engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders. The right candidate can move quickly without sacrificing trustworthiness and knows how to balance statistical rigor with the practical needs of the business. 

 

What you’ll do

  • Own model and analysis deliverables. Take a defined business problem and independently deliver a reliable model, analysis component, scoring workflow, or supporting dataset.  

  • Translate business questions into analytical approaches. Ask clarifying questions, understand how the output will be used, and recommend an approach that fits the decision, timeline, and available data.  

  • Build and test models quickly. Develop practical solutions using statistical methods, machine learning, deep learning, or existing models and services where appropriate.  

  • Prepare trustworthy data. Profile, cleanse, join, and validate noisy datasets while checking completeness, freshness, distributions, nulls, duplicates, and match rates.  

  • Create repeatable scoring workflows. Move useful work beyond the notebook by building reusable Python components, batch-scoring processes, APIs, or lightweight services.  

  • Evaluate results responsibly. Establish baselines, select appropriate metrics, perform statistical reasonableness checks, reconcile unexpected results, and clearly document limitations.  

  • Support intelligence products and applications. Work with application and data teams to define the right data ingredients, test hypotheses, and integrate model outputs into usable experiences.  

  • Add operational discipline. Include validation, monitoring, failure handling, refresh expectations, documentation, and a clear usage path in delivered work.  

  • Use AI to improve your own productivity. Apply tools such as Claude, Codex, and similar assistants to accelerate coding, testing, research, debugging, and documentation while independently verifying the results.  

  • Communicate progress early and clearly. Make milestones, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and issues visible rather than waiting until delivery.  

 

What ownership looks like at this level

You are expected to own the deliverable. That means: 

  • Working independently on a well-defined model, workflow, dataset, or component  

  • Producing reliable and repeatable outputs rather than one-time analyses  

  • Adding appropriate validation and basic monitoring  

  • Documenting assumptions, methodology, limitations, and usage  

  • Demonstrating the output and explaining how it supports the business  

  • Raising risks and ambiguity early  

  • Leaving the work in a condition that another team member can operate or extend  

 

You will receive guidance on broader product direction, methodology, and complex stakeholder decisions, but you should not require step-by-step direction to complete the work. 

 

Experience that can set you up for success

These are useful indicators rather than absolute requirements: 

  • Experience applying statistical analysis and machine learning to real business problems  

  • Strong Python skills and familiarity with libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, or TensorFlow  

  • Strong SQL skills and experience analyzing large datasets  

  • Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Athena, Hive, BigQuery, or similar technologies  

  • Experience developing classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, recommendation, optimization, or anomaly-detection solutions  

  • Familiarity with model evaluation, experimental design, feature engineering, and statistical validation  

  • Experience creating repeatable batch-scoring workflows or exposing model outputs through APIs or services  

  • Familiarity with orchestration and automation tools such as Airflow, AWS Glue, Prefect, or similar platforms  

  • Experience using version control, testing, and reproducible development practices  

  • Ability to explain analytical results and trade-offs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders  

  • Meaningful use of GenAI tools to improve the speed and quality of day-to-day work  

 

You’ll thrive here if you 

  • Are pragmatic. You select the simplest credible approach that can deliver useful business impact.  

  • Move quickly with discipline. You can produce an initial version rapidly while still validating the fundamentals.  

  • Care about trust. You check the data, question surprising results, and make limitations visible.  

  • Work well with ambiguity. You can turn an incomplete request into a clear set of questions, assumptions, and next steps.  

  • Think beyond the notebook. You consider how a model will be refreshed, accessed, demonstrated, monitored, and reused.  

  • Understand the business context. You evaluate technical decisions through the lens of client outcomes, revenue, cost, adoption, and decision quality.  

  • Are curious and low-ego. You are comfortable learning from others, revising an approach, and using an existing solution when it is better than building a new one.  

 

Early indicators of success 

Within the first several months, a successful candidate will have: 

  • Independently delivered a model, analysis workflow, or scoring component used in an active business or intelligence initiative  

  • Added repeatable validation and documentation to their deliverables  

  • Converted at least one exploratory analysis or prototype into a reusable workflow  

  • Demonstrated clear understanding of how their work supports a client, product, revenue, or operational outcome  

  • Used AI-assisted development to improve delivery speed without compromising accuracy or trust  

  • Earned confidence from data science, application, and business partners through reliable execution and clear communication 

 

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage

 

PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA

Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.  

We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here:  https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/ 

ZETA IN THE NEWS!

https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat=press-releases

title: Director, Business Development - EMEA
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

Anduril's Growth organization identifies, shapes, captures, and grows new opportunities for the company.

This role sits within the Connected Warfare Division. Connected Warfare builds the software and hardware substrate for global, multi-domain command and control (C2) — joint, time-sensitive, connected mesh ecosystems that link every robot, human, and sensor across every domain to close kill chains and enable mission autonomy. The division includes the Voyager team, which delivers ruggedised computing and communications platforms for the network edge.

About the Job

  • This is a sales role. You are here to hunt and close new business for Connected Warfare across Europe and the Middle East.
  • Based in continental Europe, you'll report to the Head of Growth for Anduril's International Connected Warfare business. You carry initial responsibility for the region, with scope to expand as the business scales.
  • European defence environments come with sovereign requirements, legacy architectures, and security constraints. You will know these pain points cold and demonstrate how Anduril integrates with — and supercharges — the systems customers already operate.
  • The work is matrixed: you'll pull on programs, engineering, capture, software, finance, partners, and customers to win. The deliverable is unambiguous: pipeline, partners, and signed contracts. This is an individual-contributor role — no direct reports. Your impact is measured in the business you build and the contracts you close

What You’ll Do

  • Drive go-to-market. Stand up and execute the Connected Warfare growth strategy across Europe and the Middle East. Identify, qualify, shape, and close complex opportunities with Allied nations, navigating international procurement cycles and sovereign requirements to secure long-term programs of record.
  • Generate and capture new business. Run a dual-track motion: hunt and close net-new customers across the region while partnering with delivery teams to scale and expand current contracts.
  • Map customer requirements. Build a working understanding of regional defence requirements, security constraints, and legacy architectures. Show how Anduril's open architecture integrates with sovereign systems to solve real operational problems.
  • Build and manage the regional channel. Identify, onboard, and manage strategic partners, resellers, system integrators, and European primes. Coordinate with Anduril's Global Defense team on teaming agreements that accelerate adoption.
  • Run the internal matrix. Maintain close working relationships across business line and division leadership, growth, programs, engineering, and corporate functions to shape opportunities and unblock execution.
  • Deliver the number. Hit financial performance targets and build the multi-year plan to back them up. Provide leadership with long-term growth and product strategy for Connected Warfare in region.
  • Inform product. Translate region-specific mission profiles, sovereign cloud requirements, and degraded-network realities back into the product roadmap.
  • Represent Anduril. Communicate technical and operational value to senior military officials, procurement officers, and partners — articulating how Lattice-enabled C2 closes kill chains in contested environments

Growth Activities

  • Use Salesforce as the system of record — accounts, pricing, points of contact, expected close dates, and all customer activity
  • Partner with Sales Engineering to refine customer solutions
  • Perform live and static demonstrations on-site or via VTC
  • Create and deliver client presentations and proposals tailored to specific customer needs
  • Identify regional contract vehicles (e.g. NATO frameworks, national procurement programmes) and lead proposal development

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in defence, dual-use, or enterprise networking sales, with at least 5 years closing business with European government and military customers
  • A proven hunter: documented record of identifying, qualifying, and closing complex deals with European Ministries of Defence (MoDs), NATO bodies, or coalition partners — opened the door, shaped the requirement, closed the contract
  • Deep familiarity with European defence procurement cycles, budgeting, and sovereign security frameworks
  • Ability to quickly master highly technical concepts (mesh networking, edge compute, C2, cloud architecture) and credibly brief senior military and technical leaders
  • A builder with high agency: has stood up a regional pipeline, country, or business line from a standing start — not just managed an existing book. Owns outcomes, prioritizes ruthlessly, operates well in greenfield environments
  • Operates effectively in a matrixed organization — partners well with BL leadership, engineering, capture, and corporate functions. Low ego, high collaboration
  • Demonstrated experience building and managing a regional channel — resellers, system integrators, and prime partnerships
  • Strong command of capture management or an equivalent enterprise sales pursuit methodology
  • Strong cross-cultural communication and negotiation skills
  • Native or fluent English; a second European language (Dutch, German, French) or Arabic is a plus
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% across Europe and the Middle East
  • Right to work in the EU; eligible to obtain and maintain EU and/or NATO-level security clearances

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior operational or industry experience in C4ISR, JADC2, or tactical communications — including service in an allied military, intelligence, or government digital/IT function
  • Established network within European military headquarters, defence procurement agencies, and European defence primes
  • Experience supporting export-controlled programs (US ITAR / EAR, UK Export Control, EU dual-use) and navigating sovereign data residency / cloud hosting regulations
  • Experience standing up a new sales region for a defence-tech or enterprise networking company


Europe and the Middle East are rearming. The next decade of defence spend in this region will be measured in the billions, and the contracts being shaped right now will run for twenty years. We're hiring the person who's going to win our share of it.

Benefits

Each customer gets a dedicated Kestra instance on dedicated infrastructure, so the platform is a fleet of isolated stacks rather than one shared cluster. It is in Beta today, running production workloads for early customers, with General Availability planned for 2027. Each instance runs arbitrary user code (scripts, containers, queries against their own systems) through hundreds of plugins, and the fleet grows with every new customer. Provisioning, upgrading, and observing dozens to hundreds of identical stacks without drift is the core problem. We're looking for a Lead Tech SRE to own Kestra Cloud end to end: the architecture and specs, the delivery, the monitoring, and the continuous improvement of the platform. Expert Terraform : you have designed module structures and state layouts that scale to many identical customer environments, not just written resources. Real on-call and incident experience , including running postmortems and turning them into durable fixes. SaaS operations background : you have run a product for paying customers, with SLOs that mattered. Fluent in English and comfortable working autonomously in a fully remote environment. Pragmatism: you pick the boring solution when it works and can explain why. Built or operated a fleet control plane for per-customer environments (Kubernetes operators, Crossplane, GKE Fleet / Config Sync, or custom provisioning services). FinOps practice on GCP: per-customer cost attribution, committed use discounts, spot node pools. Exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits from the infrastructure side. What you would do

Architecture & specs

  • Own the target architecture of Kestra Cloud on GCP: the per-customer dedicated stack (cluster, network, databases, queues), how it is templated and versioned, regions, and the path from Beta to GA.

  • Write the specs (design docs, RFCs, ADRs) that turn product needs into infrastructure work, and defend the trade-offs: cost per customer vs isolation level, GCP project vs cluster vs node pool per customer, managed service vs self-run.

  • Define SLOs and error budgets per service and per tier, and make them the basis for prioritization.

Delivery

  • Break specs into work and dispatch it across the team, then review and unblock. You set the bar for Terraform modules, Helm charts, and GitOps conventions.

  • Automate the customer instance lifecycle: provisioning, upgrades, scaling, backups, migration, and decommissioning, with no manual steps.

  • Own the release path of Kestra Cloud with ArgoCD and GitHub Actions: progressive rollouts, rollback, and upgrade safety across the whole fleet of customer instances.

🔭 What you will work on

Your mission

Drive customer success as a trusted advisor and account manager for our enterprise customers. Own a portfolio end-to-end from onboarding and tool adoption through retention and ARR growth, co-developing new value propositions and building the trust-based relationships that turn customers into advocates.
 

Over the next 12 months you will:

  1. Grow annual contract values of existing enterprise customers

    • Translate our impact into tangible business value for economic buyers.

    • Lead renewal negotiations and drive upsell opportunities with existing customers.

    • Expand our reach within global enterprises across new regions, teams, and decision-makers.

    • Build and nurture strong relationships with clients as their trusted climate advisor and single point of contact, coordinating internal expertise to deliver clear, actionable guidance on sustainability topics

    • Represent the customer voice and needs internally to provide input for product development.

    • Educate users and guide them toward measurable progress on their Net Zero journey.

  3. Boost farm-level data collection via the RootOS platform

    • Onboard sustainability managers, farm technicians, and farmers to the platform and guide their data collection efforts.

    • Ensure high data integrity, partner with trusted farm-level data sources, and meet data coverage targets.

    • Collect, consolidate, and prioritize product feedback.

 

🚀 You might be really good for this role if you

  • Have 3+ years of experience in customer-facing roles (ideally B2B SaaS, consulting, or startup/scale-up environments) where you built and nurtured strong client relationships end-to-end

title: Projectontwikkelaar
description: Wil jij bouwen aan de woningbouwopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige vastgoedprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na tendergunning en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met bouwpartners én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid. Dit wordt jouw baan Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke vastgoedprojecten en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de bouw om projecten succesvol richting uitvoering te brengen. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om in de toekomst ontwikkelaars te begeleiden en bijvoorbeeld door te groeien naar een rol als Hoofd Vastgoedontwikkeling. Wat ga je doen Deze functie richt zich nadrukkelijk niet op de initiatieffase of acquisitiekant van gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen en projecten daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd gaan worden. Je werkt aan (midel)grote woningbouwontwikkelingen van honderden woningen en bent de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het realiseren van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie. · Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning tot aan de start van de realisatie; · Je stuurt het ontwikkelproces aan op het gebied van kwaliteit, planning, financiën en risico's; · Je verbindt de belangen van gemeenten, adviseurs, beleggers, corporaties, bouwteams en andere stakeholders; · Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van Bouw om projecten optimaal uitvoerbaar en haalbaar te maken; · Je vertaalt ambities en plannen naar concrete ontwikkelbeslissingen die bijdragen aan een succesvolle uitvoering; · Je voert regie op vergunningstrajecten, overeenkomsten en besluitvorming; · Je bewaakt de businesscase en stuurt op waardecreatie gedurende het gehele ontwikkelproces; · Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere opbouw en professionalisering van de ontwikkelorganisatie; · Je begeleidt en coacht minder ervaren projectontwikkelaars en krijgt de ruimte om op termijn een meer aansturende rol te vervullen. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Hier zit je op jouw plek Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. Dat betekent dat je terechtkomt in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. Met ruim 100 collega's binnen onze werkmaatschappij bouwen we niet alleen aan duurzame woningen, utiliteitsprojecten en leefomgevingen, maar ook aan de toekomst van onze eigen organisatie. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen. Hier krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar midden in een frisse organisatie die zich verder ontwikkelt en waarin ondernemerschap, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Samen bouwen we aan projecten waar we trots op zijn én aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst. Dit breng jij mee · Minimaal 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring als projectontwikkelaar, ontwikkelmanager of vergelijkbare functie; · Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding; · Ervaring met woningbouwontwikkelingen; · Aantoonbare ervaring met projecten van substantiële omvang (200+ woningen is een pre).; · Ruime ervaring met ontwikkeltrajecten in de SO-, VO- en DO-fases, het verkrijgen van omgevingsvergunningen en verkooptrajecten; · Inzicht in bouwtechnische uitgangspunten om adviseurs aan te sturen en het plan verder uit te werken; · Ervaring binnen een ontwikkelaar, ontwikkelende bouwer of vastgoedorganisatie. Je bent een ontwikkelaar die vooral energie krijgt van de projecten na tendergunning verder te brengen richting realisatie. Je begrijpt de dynamiek van de bouw en weet hoe je samen met alle betrokken partijen woningbouwprojecten succesvol kunt ontwikkelen én realiseren. Dit bieden wij jou Het salaris voor deze functie ligt bij een medior profiel tussen € 5.639,- en € 7.049,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur) en bij een senior profiel tussen € 6.512,- en € 9.512,- (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring. Voor deze functie geldt een individuele bonusregeling, waarbij de hoogte van de bonus afhankelijk is van de behaalde resultaten. Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra). 43 verlofdagen volgens de cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen; Een laptop en een smartphone. Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap. Je hebt de keuze tussen een elektrische leaseauto, een mobiliteitsbudget of NS Business Card. Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike. Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar ook op het gebied van vitaliteit. Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland. Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibel werken beleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical. Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de 5 weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%. Wil jij ook meer uit je werk halen? Dan zijn wij nieuwsgierig naar jou! Solliciteren kan direct via onze website middels de solliciteerbutton onder de vacature. Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze recruiter Bel, whatsapp of e-mail interim recruiter Arnold van Stade via 06-18702179 of ----- style="min-height: 1.7em;"> Bij Dura Vermeer werven en selecteren we onze kandidaten graag zonder de goedbedoelde hulp van “onderaannemers”. Bij acquisitie behouden we ons het recht voor om meerwerk in rekening te brengen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Financieel Strategisch Adviseur | Gemeente Zwolle
description: Omschrijving Wij zijn voor de Gemeente Zwolle op zoek naar een Senior Financieel Strategisch Adviseur. Binnen de afdeling Concernstaf werk je aan een strategische en impactvolle opgave: het ontwikkelen van een integraal Meerjarig Investeringsplan (MIP) met een horizon van tien jaar en een bijbehorend financieel sturingskader. De gemeente staat de komende jaren voor grote investeringen op het gebied van woningbouw, gebiedsontwikkeling, onderwijshuisvesting en infrastructuur. Tegelijkertijd vragen financiële schaarste, beperkte uitvoeringscapaciteit en netcongestie om scherpe keuzes en integrale afwegingen. In deze opdracht zorg je voor een toekomstbestendige financiële aanpak die inzicht geeft in investeringen, risico’s, financiële consequenties en prioriteiten binnen de gemeentelijke investeringsportefeuille. Deze interim opdracht is interessant voor een ervaren strategisch financieel adviseur met ruime ervaring binnen gemeentelijke organisaties, financiële sturing en investeringsvraagstukken in het fysieke domein. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integraal Meerjarig Investeringsplan (MIP) met een looptijd van tien jaar. Je ontwikkelt een financieel sturingskader voor gemeentelijke investeringen, inclusief financiële uitgangspunten en besluitvormingscriteria. Je ontwikkelt een methodiek voor integrale prioritering van investeringsprojecten op basis van financiële, bestuurlijke en organisatorische factoren. Je adviseert over de aansluiting van het MIP en het sturingskader op de planning- en controlcyclus (P&C-cyclus). Je verzorgt de implementatie, overdracht en documentatie zodat de organisatie zelfstandig kan doorwerken met de ontwikkelde instrumenten. Wat vragen wij? Eisen: Je hebt een afgeronde hbo-bacheloropleiding. Je hebt minimaal 10 jaar ervaring als strategisch financieel adviseur of in een vergelijkbare financieel-strategische adviesfunctie. Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen een gemeentelijke organisatie. Aanvullende wensen: Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen van financieel instrumentarium. Je hebt ruime kennis van en ervaring met gemeentefinanciën. Je hebt ervaring met financiële vraagstukken binnen het fysieke domein, zoals gebiedsontwikkeling, woningbouw of infrastructuur. Je hebt gewerkt binnen een groeiende gemeente met meer dan 100.000 inwoners. Je hebt ervaring met advisering aan bestuur, directie en senior management. Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen en opleveren van een Meerjarig Investeringsplan (MIP). Competenties Je beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Je hebt gevoel voor politiek-bestuurlijke verhoudingen en stakeholders. Je bent daadkrachtig, resultaatgericht en brengt complexe opgaven tot een concreet eindresultaat. Je werkt zelfstandig en zoekt op het juiste moment actief de samenwerking op. Informatie Start: Zo snel mogelijk Aantal uur: 24 tot 36 uur per week Lengte opdracht: 6 maanden met optie tot verlenging Locatie: Zwolle Vorm: ZZP Geïnteresseerd? Graag ontvangen wij jouw CV voor maandag 9 november 9.00 uur met contactgegevens en de beschikbaarheid. Wij geven je op korte termijn een inhoudelijke reactie op jouw interesse in de interim opdracht.
